title: New website review
body:
Awesome job on the new documentation & website 👍  I really like the new getting started & guides 💯

A few minor issues I've spotted:

* \[x] Would love to have a sticky left menu
* \[x] Wondering whether we should push ES6 syntax or not in examples?
* \[x] the DocSearch implementation is still referencing the Android index :)
* \[x] Homepage's hero is not responsive
* \[x] On the `/instantsearch.html` page, the markdown is broken:

![screen shot 2017-05-10 at 08 51 38](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/29529/25886472/ffb8a9b8-355d-11e7-923c-8049539c9157.png)
